source_title: Phantom Blade Zero: Where to Find Huang Manor Key
source_excerpt:
Pangzhen is the fourth and largest region in Phantom Blade Zero , with numerous Bells and alleyways to explore for collectibles. While progressing through the region, you will eventually reach the Huang Manor Crossroads Bell , with a locked manor door nearby.
The key is also found in Pangzhen, but you will need to progress further through the main story to obtain it. This guide covers where to find the key and how to complete the request at the manor.
How to Get the Huang Manor Key in Phantom Blade Zero
From the locked door at Huang Manor, head west to continue through the main story. You will eventually reach Myst's Tavern , where you will see cutscenes involving Myst and the Crane Bell. Afterward, head inside the tavern to find several NPCs, many of whom have quests for you to complete in Pangzhen and other regions.
Image via GameRant | Sources: S-GAME
Look for Shopkeeper Niu , who is sitting on a chair inside the tavern. Speak to him, and he will tell you about Huang Manor and how the maids inside turned into wooden Puppets. Soul will offer to investigate the manor, and you will receive the Huang Manor Key. With the key in your possession, travel back to the Huang Manor Crossroads Bell to unlock the door and explore the manor.
Where to Find All Medicine Pot Fragments in Huang Manor
Once you enter Huang Manor, pick up the Tainted Crystal Shard and go through the open doorway on the left. Defeat the Puppet in the first room, then proceed into the next room to find the Medicine Pot Fragment: Chain .
Continue into the following room and head right first to collect the Medicine Pot Fragment: Handle . Afterward, turn around and go up the stairs, where you will encounter several more Puppet enemies. Defeat them and loot the room to obtain a Tainted Crystal Shard, a Refined Indigo Shard , and the Medicine Pot Fragment: Body .
Proceed to the next room, where you will find two Traversal Talismans , a letter, and a Memory Flower on the left. Interacting with the Memory Flower will start the A Brother Once More quest.
Before leaving, turn around and collect the Medicine Pot Fragment: Lid . Since this is the final accessory fragment , you will obtain the Manor Medicine Pot accessory, completing your collection of the four fragments.
After exploring Huang Manor and collecting the items inside, return to Shopkeeper Niu at Myst's Tavern. Speak to him again, and he will tell you more about Jin, adding a new location to your map and allowing you to continue A Brother Once More quest.
